variety kind

  • CURIE: gmeow:varietyKind
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/varietyKind
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/languages

The sociolinguistic classification(s) of a language variety — dialect, sociolect, register, idiolect, slang, standard, etc. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single variety may carry multiple classifications from different standpoints simultaneously (Principle 9), and classifications change over time via new claims rather than overwrite (Principle 10).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:LanguageVariety -> gmeow:LanguageVarietyKind

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:varietyKind from gmeow:LanguageVariety to gmeow:LanguageVarietyKind when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:LanguageVariety, gmeow:LanguageVarietyKind
